timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: What is CIEM? Another security acronym escaped from a lab?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management. It finds who can do what across your cloud estate.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: RBAC is the raw permission model. CIEM analyzes effective permissions and risky combinations.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: The real result after roles, groups, inherited scopes, service principals, and stale assignments collide.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Yes, especially identities with permissions they never use. Those are attack paths waiting politely.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Inventory permissions, remove unused rights, require just-in-time elevation, and monitor privilege drift.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: It is. Nobody plans chaos. They approve it one exception at a time.
